designBrief: Irreverent neighbourhood sandwich-and-pizza spot at The Poiz Centre, Singapore. Palette from the business's own real logo (warm cream, rust/terracotta lettering) plus a three-band rainbow accent lifted directly from a real hand-painted sign in their space. Zilla Slab (chunky, echoes the hand-lettered logo) for headings, Source Sans 3 for body. Single-page, warm editorial-photography-led (this business already has professional food photography), confident/irreverent tone, minimal nav. Signature element: the flat three-band rainbow rule used sparingly as a hero underline and a Day/Night menu divider.
